label: Start SvelteKit dev server
command: if curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:5173/ >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; nohup npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 >/tmp/pi-squared-vite-5173.log 2>&1 & for attempt in $(seq 1 120); do if curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:5173/ >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; sleep 0.25; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for the SvelteKit dev server. See /tmp/pi-squared-vite-5173.log.' >&2; exit 1
